_about: Monitored channels. You must be SUBSCRIBED to each in your own Telegram app (mute + archive them). The bot never joins anything.
_reliability: Per-source probability that a town match here means a real threat. Combined across sources as 1 - PROD(1 - r). One reliable source = 90%, all four = 100%, the local news channel alone = 50%.
_requiresThreat: true = message must ALSO contain a danger keyword (config/threat-keywords.json). Only for channels that publish non-threat content.
_webPreview: false = channel genuinely publishes no t.me/s page. A transient 302 is NOT this — it recovers on its own, is handled by backoff, and is logged as [scrape:302].
